annotations.text:
inferbus console — v1 mockup (static).
Every screen maps 1:1 to the /admin/v1/* API in the 2026-09-07 design spec. Humans sign in via OIDC; API keys are data-plane only.

OIDC only — no API-key sign-in.
Roles resolve from org_members / platform_admins (spec §9.2).

GET /admin/v1/usage?window=7d
Aggregates come from the ClickHouse materialized views (spec §10). Budget bars read usage_daily_by_key.

GET/POST /admin/v1/keys · rotate/disable via POST /admin/v1/keys/{id}/rotate|disable (spec §9.1).
Allowlist chips = aliases, never concrete models.

GET/PUT/DELETE /admin/v1/aliases (global + org scope) · POST /admin/v1/aliases/resync.
Projection column shows ALIASES KV write-through state (spec §6.1).
GET /admin/v1/workers — read-through of the MODELS KV heartbeat bucket (spec §6.2). Read-only: workers are configured by their local YAML, not from the console.
